svg.text: Input: three-phase supply (phase) voltages v_an, v_bn, v_cn, peak V_m
grey dotted = natural commutation points (30°, 90°, 150° …; firing here means α = 0)
orange = gate pulse of T1 … T6 (60° apart); firing is delayed by α from each grey dotted line
Output voltage v_o (R load). Dashed grey = six line voltages; bold = conducting pair
